study: Jay et al. 2017 (Dialogic Teaching, EEF evaluation, Sheffield Hallam)
delivery_evidence: PD = in-person induction/training days and plenary sessions led by the delivery team plus an in-school mentor, combined with access to project-website materials and two video presentations used for ongoing self-evaluation/development; mix of face-to-face and online/video components (Intervention/IPDM section; 'What (materials)' and Training/induction/plenaries lists).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are the commercially published, independently developed GL Assessment Progress Tests in English, Maths, and Science, not tailored to the intervention (Table 7, p.26).
curriculum_evidence: Dialogic Teaching changes classroom talk/pedagogy across the existing curriculum ('change classroom talk across the curriculum'); teachers receive handbooks/reference packs and a mentoring manual but adopt no new subject curriculum (Intervention description; exec summary point 5).
outcome_timing_evidence: Posttests administered May 2016 at the end of the 2-term (autumn+spring 2015/16) intervention = immediate post-test (Table 7, p.26; design narrative p.9).
